CustomObject.label: Sync Run Event
CustomObject.description: Published by DeltaSyncJob after every page commits: which mailbox, which page, how many records, and the stage reached (running/throttled/invalid_token/completed/failed). A subscribing LWC (syncMonitor, referenced in the write-up) uses empApi to show a live run without polling. This is the direct analogue of "the stage is written on the record" in the Deluge version, made push-based instead of pull-based.
